maria (product): Quick sync on the orchestration contract for multi-tool flows — need to lock MVP scope + launch criteria by EOD so eng can plan sprint.

alex (eng): TL;DR: goal is a first-class API surface to express multiple tool invokes per user request, with control over ordering and timeouts.

maria (product): Correct. Customers asking for: (1) fan-out to multiple enrichers (embeddings, rulings), (2) sequential chains where outputs feed next tool, (3) retries and per-tool timeouts, (4) structured merged output.

tyler (ml): We should decide whether model-run orchestration (LLM calls orchestrate tools) or platform-run orchestration (platform invokes tools based on model directives). Both have implications.

alex (eng): Prefer platform-run orchestration MVP: deterministic routing, better observability, easier to enforce SLAs. Model-driven orchestration can come later as advanced feature.

ben (research): Agreed. For rerank/embeddings: platform can call embedding service once, cache results, fan-out rerankers in parallel. That avoids repeated embed costs.

sara (solutions): Customers want semantics for ordering: some toolchains require strict order, others don't. We should offer an `ordering` param with values `parallel | sequential | priority` and a simple default.

alex (eng): Implementation note: `parallel` means we fire n requests concurrently and aggregate. `sequential` means outputs feed next input. `priority` will be best-effort parallel but we surface ordering hints.

kevin (security): Need to surface per-tool data residency and KMS controls in the API. If a tool touches customer PII, platform must honor VPC/private deployment constraints.

maria (product): For MVP scope proposal: 1) Support up to 4 parallel tool calls per request. 2) Support sequential chaining with explicit `next_input` mapping. 3) Per-tool timeout + global deadline. 4) Idempotency token for whole orchestration. 5) Structured output envelope that maps tool results by name.

alex (eng): +1 but propose reducing to 3 parallel calls to simplify batching & KV cache semantics on day 1. Also says we should limit chain depth to 3 for the MVP.

ben (research): Depth 3 seems fine. Also define merge strategy for conflicting outputs: `first_success`, `merge-json`, `prefer-primary`. Keep only `first_success` and `merge-json` for MVP.

maria (product): Decision: parallel limit = 3, chain depth = 3, merge strategies = ["first_success","merge-json"]. We'll document later if customers need `prefer-primary`.

sara (solutions): UX: request body example please. We should aim for a single request shape that can express both parallel and sequential flows. Example snippet: ```json
{"input":"...",
 "tools":[
  {"name":"embed_service","mode":"parallel","timeout_ms":500},
  {"name":"entity_extractor","mode":"sequential","timeout_ms":1000}
 ]
}
```

alex (eng): Nice. We'll add `id` per tool and `depends_on` to express explicit wiring for sequential flows. Implementation can map `depends_on` to input templates.

tyler (ml): For model integration: include `tool_outputs` in the LLM prompt as structured JSON and allow `function_result` style tokens so customers can continue reasoning in-model. But initial orchestration remains platform-executed.

kevin (security): Add audit metadata per tool call (caller, region, KMS key id) to the structured output envelope. Needed for Private and Dedicated customers.

maria (product): Launch criteria (must-met) proposal: - API stable shape documented + SDKs - End-to-end p95 latency for parallel 3 calls < 600ms on typical workloads - Cost uplift < 2x single-call baseline for small chains - Observability events + tracing for every tool invoke - On/off flag for orchestration at account level

alex (eng): Engineering risk: batching & KV cache interaction may blow p95. We should opt for conservative default: synchronous aggregation but async streaming option only behind feature flag.

ben (research): Add quality gating: automated evals identical to rerank tests — we should include a small prompt-set and run canary traffic to detect regressions when enabling orchestration.

sara (solutions): Rollout plan: canary to early access customers who asked (3 customers), collect telemetry for 2 weeks, then open beta. Provide migration guide and sample patterns.

maria (product): Scope negotiation: cut for MVP = no model-driven orchestration, no dynamic tool discovery on request, no multi-region fallback. Can re-evaluate for M2.

alex (eng): Implementation checklist: API shape, server-side router, per-tool worker adapters, timeout/enforcer, aggregator, observability hooks, SDK helpers, canary flag. Est 6 sprints with 2 engs + 1 infra for first pass.

kevin (security): Compliance checklist: per-tool dataflow map, KMS integration verified, audit logs exported to customer S3/Kafka for Private. Need signoff before GA.

deploy-bot: deploy requested by alex (eng) for branch orch/mvp -> staging at 1796002668.

alex (eng): Quick open question: retries semantics. My proposal: platform does 0 automatic retries by default at tool level. Provide `retry_policy` optional per tool: {attempts, backoff_ms, retry_on:["5xx","timeout"]}. For sequential chains, retries may change semantics — must be explicit.

maria (product): Sounds right. Default no-retry to avoid surprising double-effects. Doc example needed to warn about idempotency.

ben (research): For rerank use-case: prefer single-call aggregator that accepts multiple candidate ids rather than firing separate rerank tools per candidate. We should document recommended patterns to keep costs down.

sara (solutions): Also give customers `dry_run=true` to validate wiring without executing external actions. Helpful for integration testing and security review.

maria (product): Next steps: alex to write initial API spec PR by EOD, include request/response examples and SDK pseudo-code. tyler + ben to propose eval suites. kevin to create security checklist draft. sara will line up customers for canary.

alex (eng): Will do. PR will include the `tools` schema, `ordering`, `depends_on`, `timeout_ms`, `retry_policy`, `merge_strategy`, and example telemetry events.

maria (product): Thanks. If no objections, we'll freeze MVP scope tomorrow morning and add to roadmap. :thumbsup:

kevin (security): +1 from security.

tyler (ml): +1.

sara (solutions): +1.

ben (research): +1.

alex (eng): +1.

maria (product): Great — closing thread.
